description: This Python script processes input and PID files to generate an output file containing the PID (from file or hex string), SHA-256 hash of input data, and the input data itself. It provides command-line interface for specifying input/output files and PID information.

methods.name: create_output(args)
methods.description: Reads input and PID files or hex string, computes SHA-256 hash of the input file, and writes the PID bytes, hash digest, and input bytes to the output file.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Sets up argument parsing, validates arguments, and calls create_output to perform the main processing.
